name: Luminous dial
summary: A dial with hands and marks that carry paint that glows in the dark, so that the wearer reads the time without a lamp.
how: Paint the numerals and the hands with a luminous compound.
Apply a layer of at least 0.2 mm, so that the glow lasts the night.
Choose tritium or strontium aluminate paint, because radium paint is no longer safe.

origin.note: The Radium Luminous Material Corporation starts to sell luminous paint.

adoptions.via: A radium paint dial makes a wristwatch that soldiers read in the dark of the trench.
The pilot watch carries large numerals and hands filled with luminous paint for the night cockpit.
The diver watch carries large luminous markers, so that the diver reads it in dark water.
